## 🎉 Kobralink 1.0

Kobralink reaches **1.0.0**. This release would not exist without [@riccardoalv](https://github.com/riccardoalv) (Ricardo Alves da Silva), whose work in [#6](https://github.com/nathacks/Kobralink/pull/6) brought most of what makes this version:

- **More printers**: Kobra 4 support with the printer's real model, an external spool slot for printers without an ACE, a protocol aligned with Anycubic's LAN client
- **Dashboard**: printer cards with camera, progress, temperatures and filament; a redesigned printer page with the camera at native quality
- **Printing**: 3D preview and per-print options, calibration options, estimated cost before printing, history with previews and a cost breakdown
- **Automation**: a single queue with a configurable automatic start, scheduled prints with a calendar and a clock dial, bed-clear hold, maintenance, automations
- **Home Assistant**: per-print energy, smart plug selection, camera frames published whatever the print state
- **ACE**: slot status, remaining filament, drying faults, spool illustrations
- **Quality**: Vitest + Testing Library on the web, pt-br translation, many fixes (settings no longer reset, Discord/ntfy links, uploads from OrcaSlicer)

Thank you Ricardo 🙏
